C1.why: He changed ليل to ليلة in the same second that Amal said ليلة, so this reads as his own fix rather than her correction.

C2.why: He said مع حادث, she recast it as معها, and he repeated عمل معها حادث.

C3.why: He asked whether بالأخيرة meant 'finally', so this is a word he did not know, not a slip.

C4.why: He used جديدة with no noun, she prompted 'a new one', and he rebuilt it as وحدة جديدة.

C5.why: He left the object ending off the verb, she prompted 'to bring it' and then said نجيبها.

C6.why: He said مفتاح for 'open', and she said 'No, that's key' and led him to مفتوح.

C7.why: His line is missing, but her 'No... مراجعة is a review' shows she rejected the noun he used where the verb was needed.

C8.why: She said his ba'ad means 'sit', not 'spend', and gave ba2addi.

C9.why: She said No to his past form and typed addait, though his own words are missing.

C10.why: Her 'لا... بس مش علا' rejects 3ala with bat2assaf and gives la or min instead.

C11.why: This is a wrong date, not a language error, and his own words are mostly missing.

C12.why: He used masculine أزرق with feminine بلوزة, she stressed بلوزة and questioned أزرق, and he changed it to زرقة.

C13.why: Amal said he got it right, and he was already saying التاني.

C14.why: She said 'No, wait' to مش نفس المكان and explained that مكان is the first word of an idafa, so it takes no el-.

C15.why: He said هادي for a masculine noun, and she recast it as هذا and gave the reason.

C16.why: He said هادي again in the full sentence a minute later, and she corrected it to هذا again.

C17.why: He used هذا for feminine مرة, she said 'mish hada', and he switched to هادي.

C18.why: He said يكون with feminine هادي, she cued 'It's kun', and he fixed it to تكون.

C19.why: This is the same mixed-up 'last time' mistake that C21 covers better.

C20.why: He chose إلي himself and Amal did not correct anything.

C21.why: She said مرة الأخيرة doesn't make sense and gave المرة الأخيرة or آخر مرة.

C22.why: He used تكون for 'was', she said 'No, it was', and he reached كانت.

C23.why: He used masculine أزرق for the car, she recast it as zar2a, and he said زرقاء.

C24.why: He reached for إلي, she prompted 'what does it turn into', and he said لصحابي.

C25.why: His homework had plural أخرين, she asked why he used the plural, and he rebuilt it as أخر شغل إلهم.

C26.why: He said بتعب, and she corrected the start to بيـ.

C27.why: He actually said تأسفي, so there was no آسفي to correct.

C28.why: She asked 'Why? Do I need اللي?' and he dropped illi after the indefinite noun.

C29.why: He said تشوفي with no b-, and she recast it as بتشوفي.

C30.why: He was searching for a word he did not know yet ('upset'), and she only glossed his guesses.

C31.why: She said No to both his guesses (la and 3ala) and gave من, which he then used.

C32.why: He said زعجتي, she said 'No, it's an N verb', and he fixed it to انزعجتي.

C33.why: She recast ملان as بكون ملان and explained that it is a habit.

C34.why: He tried اشتقت على, she said No, and he switched to لـ.

C35.why: He used the singular for 'my vacations', and she recast it as إجازاتي.

C36.why: She cued 'When I didn't have' and he added كان.

C37.why: She said لا لا لا to شركتي تبعي and gave feminine تبعتي.

C38.why: This is the same missing 'happy for' preposition that C40 covers at the moment she prompted it.

C39.why: She recast الشهر العسل as شهر العسل (and بنقدر as ونقدر), and he repeated it.

C40.why: She said he didn't use 'happy for' and prompted until he said لـ.

C41.why: She said آخر ليلة doesn't mean yesterday and gave ليلة امبارح.

C42.why: She said لا to لا رجعت and told him the verb after la- is present.

C43.why: He just echoed her offer, she did not correct the gender, and the real correction is covered by C41.

C44.why: This is the same 'last night' correction as C41, and she had offered الماضية herself.

C45.why: She said No to عن and led him to على.

C46.why: She questioned وحشي and said it doesn't mean 'wild', so he picked another adjective.

C47.why: She said لا to ولد عمي and he reached ابن عمي.
